methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops in Hampton Roads targeting community access signal grassroots capability-building that could distribute deeper AI literacy beyond traditional tech hubs, testing whether peer-led models can overcome metro concentration patterns.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce indicates the capital region is experiencing skill-shift demands typical of metro tech centers, reinforcing Richmond's position as a secondary hub while implicitly widening gaps with non-metro regions facing different economic transitions.

signals.title: ODU, CHKD want to map hotspots of childhood asthma in Hampton Roads with AI - WHRO
signals.signal_reading: ODU and CHKD deploying AI for childhood asthma mapping demonstrates institutional deep capability concentrated in Hampton Roads' research-healthcare nexus, showing how specialized AI applications cluster around existing centers of technical and medical expertise.

signals.title: Norfolk, Newport News police launch AI tool for non-emergency calls - 13newsnow.com
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk and Newport News police adopting turnkey AI for non-emergency calls exemplifies shallow, platform-delivered adoption that distributes AI functionality without building local technical depth—operational efficiency without capability transfer.

signals.title: Rural advocacy groups band together to oppose data centers, related energy projects
signals.signal_reading: Rural groups opposing data centers and energy projects suggests resistance infrastructure that could benefit from AI-driven economic development, signaling potential for neither deep capability nor broad distribution to materialize in underserved regions despite proximity to major tech infrastructure investments.
